text: ）中共中央政治局委员、外交部长王毅14日在北京同所罗门群岛外交和外贸部长霍尼普维拉举行会谈。王毅表示，事实证明，中所建交站在历史正确一边。中方愿同所新政府共同努力，推动中所关系不断迈上新台阶。中方发展同太平洋岛国关系，是为了加强南南合作，促进共同发展，没有地缘政治意图，不谋求所谓“势力范围”，不应受到第三方干扰。太平洋岛国有权自主选择发展伙伴。（新华社）
text_en: CPC Central Committee Political Bureau member and Foreign Minister Wang Yi held talks in Beijing on the 14th with Solomon Islands' Minister of Foreign Affairs and External Trade, Peter Shanel Agovaka. Wang Yi stated that facts have proven that China and Solomon Islands established diplomatic relations on the right side of history. China is willing to work with the new Solomon Islands government to continuously elevate bilateral relations to new heights. China's development of relations with Pacific Island countries aims to strengthen South-South cooperation and promote common development, without geopolitical intentions or pursuit of a so-called 'sphere of influence', and should not be interfered with by third parties. Pacific Island countries have the right to independently choose their development partners. (Xinhua News Agency)
